title: More Than a Bike Tour—It’s a Personal Photoshoot!
text: This bike tour was easily the highlight of our trip! The route was fantastic and well-paced, but what truly made the experience unforgettable was our incredible guide Luba.Not only did she share fascinating local insights and history at every stop, but they also doubled as our personal professional photographer! Instead of forcing awkward selfies or worrying about capturing the perfect shot, we could just enjoy the ride. Tapas at the end topped off a great tour.
author: GJBix

title: Most enjoyable tour!
text: Such an amazing tour! Best way to see the Gothic Quarter and highlights of Barcelona. Our guide was encouraging and enthusiastic!
author: annanO8031RJ

title: Amazing ride!
text: To see Barcelona up close and hear interesting stories, take this tour! We were lucky to ride with Love, who was very attentive to our small, ad hoc group of cyclists, ages 10 to 70! You can enjoy this tour on a regular bike or e-bike. Love takes pictures all along the way, making it easy to relax and be “in the moment.” If you include tapas, you’ll be delighted by the stop in a local cafe and the delicious lunch/snacks! Highly recommend for experience and quality of service!
author: blynnolson

title: Great bike tour
text:
Such a great experience on this bike tour in Barcelona! The guide was fantastic, super friendly, knowledgeable and made the whole tour really enjoyable. The route was perfect and gave us a great feel for the city.

And the photos were amazing! A really special touch that made the experience even more memorable. Highly recommend this tour if you’re visiting Barcelona
author: vicenzor164

title: Loved seeing the sights...
text: Loved seeing the sights and gave us a feel of Barcelona on our first day. Good pace, got a few minutes to explore at some places and loved Luba. Kept us in the shade as much as possible. Felt I could ask anything. Delicious food and fun way to finish with our new friends.
author: Peter_E

title: Top experience!
text:
We had a fantastic time on the bike tour,  the guide was so friendly, the tapas were delicious, and having a photographer was a great bonus. They sent us a link afterward with tons of beautiful photos.
We also booked the boat tour through them, and it was a dream, good food and drinks, a super kind crew, and the perfect number of people on board. Both tours felt personal and well-organized. Highly recommended!

title: Amazing Bike Experience

author: Tourist50472986116

title: A "Must-Do" in Barcelona!
text: This is a "Must-Do" while in Barcelona. I recommend doing it at the beginning of your trip to get the lay of the land. Martin was friendly, organized and led a fun and efficient tour through Barcelona. The bike lanes can be a little tricky so I was grateful we had a local guiding us and explaining everything to us. We stopped at some great spots to learn about the history of Barcelona, including that some palm trees came from Florida before the 1992 Olympics! My favorite parts including the photos and the tapas at the end. He knows the BEST place for tapas after cycling. We even met his sweet
author: 327mollyc

title: If you enjoy biking, don’t miss this tour!
text: Martin was fantastic! He was pleasant, personable and a great photographer. It was wonderful to see so many sights of Barcelona and know you were getting professional quality pictures and not worry about snapping photos, it let you enjoy the sights more. He took us to a great Tapas restaurant after the ride. It was  definitely one of the highlights of our vacation and  a must do when visiting  Barcelona, you will not be disappointed. Oh by the way, my wife and I are over 60, so age isn’t a problem!
author: Jeffrey_G
